content.short: Plena Finance provides a smart wallet that lets you swap, lend, transfer, bridge, and add liquidity with a single tap.
content.description: Plena Finance is a smart wallet designed for NFT, metaverse, and web3 enthusiasts, prioritizing ease of use while keeping funds under the user’s full control. This wallet enables paying transaction fees in any token, promises up to 30% cheaper transactions, and grants immediate access to funds. With one app for all your needs, it also offers simple wallet recovery and maintains full custody of assets, delivering fast transactions to support active participation in the digital economy. Its design extends across supported networks, helping simplify custody and speed up everyday crypto activity.
content.meta: Plena Finance is a smart wallet for NFT, metaverse, and web3. Discover Plena Finance and other Web3 Wallets on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
